# RogueIQ

> Smarter about money. For you and your AI. Free money tools you can play with in seconds, built on public data you can check. Your agent can plug into every one.

Every tool is built once and works three ways: a web page for people, a JSON API, and an MCP server for agents. Web tools run in the browser; inputs stay on the device. RogueIQ builds education and tools, not personalized financial advice.

## Tools

- [Net Worth by Age Checker](https://rogueiq.github.io/networth-by-age/): See how your net worth compares with US families your age, using the Federal Reserve's 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances. API: https://rogueiq-tools.rogueiq.workers.dev/v1/networth-by-age

## Charts (each chart lists its sources)

- [All charts](https://rogueiq.com/charts/)
- [Companies now spend more of the economy on tech than at the dot-com peak](https://rogueiq.com/charts/#ai-capex-gdp) (2026-10-19): Companies now spend a bigger share of the economy on tech than at the dot-com peak. Sources: BEA via FRED: A679RC1Q027SBEA <https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/A679RC1Q027SBEA>; BEA via FRED: GDP <https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/GDP>
- [How a 3x fund loses on a round trip](https://rogueiq.com/charts/#leveraged-decay) (2026-10-19): If the index drops 10% and recovers, a 3x fund is still down about 7%. Sources: Direxion SOXL fund page (daily reset); Yahoo Finance SOXL closes
- [Last week: the pros sold. The crowd bought 3x.](https://rogueiq.com/charts/#pros-vs-crowd) (2026-10-19): Last week hedge funds sold while retail investors poured a record $7B+ into SOXL, a 3x leveraged chip fund. Sources: Goldman prime book via Investing.com; SOXL inflows, Investing.com; Korean retail flows, SEIBro
- [$MSTR and Metaplanet could be cut from MSCI indexes](https://rogueiq.com/charts/#msci-btc) (2026-10-16): Bitcoin makes up about 94.5% of Strategy's assets and about 97.9% of Metaplanet's, which is why MSCI is weighing whether they still count as operating companies. Sources: Strategy Q2 2026 10-Q; Metaplanet 1H 2026 results; MSCI

## Build log

- 2026-10-19: Opened the Net Worth by Age Checker to AI agents: a free JSON API and MCP server using the same Fed data and math as the web page, tested to give the same answers.
- 2026-10-19: Started the chart archive. Every chart we post gets logged with its script, data files and source links.
- 2026-10-19: Rebuilt the rogueiq.com home page preview around one idea: every tool works for people and for their AI agents.
- 2026-10-19: Added sliders to the Net Worth by Age Checker for age, net worth and income. Results update as you slide, and typing an exact amount still works. Same math, re-tested.
- 2026-10-17: Launched the Net Worth by Age Checker (Fed SCF 2025 data, six filters).
